purpose: Minimal WebM export encoder candidate; licensing and redistribution not approved
reviewNotes: This is a candidate configuration, not a proven build command. Exact FFmpeg configure option names and required transitive components must be validated against pinned FFmpeg source.
Version3 is prohibited in this initial candidate as a conservative review gate, not because it always implies GPL licensing.
Disable-everything may require explicit enablement of additional decoders, parsers, filters, formats, devices or protocols after compile and smoke testing.
License classification must be based on actual compiled configuration and all linked libraries; absence of GPL flags alone does not establish redistribution compliance.
No production package, binaries, signing, notarization or distribution is authorized.
